_note: Batch 22 — four PlanForge tools plus composition_motif_bind_edit's EIGHTH arm. All four plan tools require a real `run_id`, which a fresh book has not got, so the whole batch would have been precondition-blocked. It is not, because plan_propose_spec declares `mode: rules` — 'heading matcher, sync, only fits documents written in its vocabulary' — which is DETERMINISTIC and spends NO LLM tokens. Smoke-tested before writing these scenarios: it returns async=false and lands the run immediately at status='proposed'. (My first draft of this note said 'compiled' — I had misread a truncated JSON blob — and the wrong status in a seed assertion then cost 5 of 5 runs on one scenario.) That is the difference between measuring four tools and recording four refusals, and it was found by reading the tool's own argument declaration rather than assuming a plan needs an LLM.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM plan_run WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: ONE real plan run, seeded deterministically through mode='rules' so no LLM tokens are spent building the fixture. This is the EMPTY case for this tool by construction: the run exists but no material search has ever been run against it, and this tool's whole purpose is returning the LAST packet WITHOUT running a new one. So 'there is no packet yet' is the honest answer, and it must be distinguishable from 'the packet is empty'.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the reply reports material findings for a run that has never been searched, OR — the specific trap this tool's own description names — it silently runs a NEW search. Its description says it is 'free, and it spends nothing. Use this before plan_find_missing_material so the author does not pay twice', so a spend here would defeat the tool's only reason to exist.

ship_audit.empty_case: This scenario IS the empty case — a run with no prior material check.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a run_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — book-scoped, and run_id is a second identifier that must be checked against the book.

# Emberfall

## Arc I — The Emberfall
### Chapter 1 — The Ember Codex
Aldric Vane climbs the black stair.
### Chapter 2 — The Waterline
The Obsidian Trench is walkable only at low tide.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM plan_run WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: A real plan run at status='proposed', seeded deterministically through mode='rules' so no LLM tokens build the fixture. 🔴 CORRECTED: my first draft asserted status='compiled' and lost 5 of 5 runs to SEED ASSERTION FAILED. I had misread the smoke output — its JSON was truncated mid-object and I took a 'compiled' from elsewhere in the blob as the run's status. Verified against the store afterwards: mode='rules' lands the run at 'proposed'. The source document is deliberately thin — two chapters, no cast, no world rules — so the plan genuinely IS missing material. 🔴 STATUS DROPPED FROM THE ASSERTION, and the reason is worth keeping: mode='rules' lands the run at 'compiled' when the document has enough structure to compile (two arcs) and at 'proposed' when it does not (one arc). I asserted 'compiled' first (cost 5 runs), then 'corrected' to 'proposed' (cost 5 more) — both were true, for different inputs, and neither was safe to assert. The run EXISTING is what the fixture needs; its status is the tool's business.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the reply reports material as `recovered` that is not in the seeded document — its description defines recovered as 'the plan already has this, from the read', so a recovered item the document does not contain is fabrication of the worst kind here, since the author would believe their plan is more complete than it is.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a plan missing nothing must say so rather than invent gaps.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a run_id that does not exist must be refused.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a revision is applied with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR the tool reports `applied` when nothing changed — that is the exact dishonesty its own description forbids (D-PF-APPLY-HONEST), and it is the same class as the arc_template archive reporting success over zero rows — OR the model invents a run_id.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a run_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — applying the same revision twice must be `no_change` the second time, not a second `applied`.

### Chapter 2 — The Waterline

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM chapters WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: ONE chapter — the fixture's own — before anything is applied. This tool CREATES real book chapters from a previewed proposal, so the count moving is the whole signal. The card is never approved, so it must still be 1 afterwards. CONTROL: `proposal_id` comes from plan_bootstrap_propose, which has NOT been run here, so the honest outcome may be a refusal naming the missing proposal — a PRECONDITION finding rather than a tool defect.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: chapters are created with NO confirm card (Tier A — this materialises real book content), OR the model invents a proposal_id, OR the reply claims chapters were created while the card is still pending. Store check: loreweave_book.chapters stays at 1.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A, and it creates real chapters.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a proposal_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — applying the same proposal twice must not create the chapters twice.

scenarios.prompt: Attach the pattern called Emberfall Thread to the opening arc of this book.
scenarios.prompt_source: meta.synonyms['attach pattern to chapter'] + ['bind motif'], verbatim.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM motif_application WHERE motif_id=(SELECT id FROM motif WHERE code='emberfall-thread-b22-{run_id}')
seed_assert.why: ZERO bindings for THIS motif. EIGHTH ARM: 38 attempts produced 0 clean runs, then arm seven produced 1 — a run that called the tool and minted its Tier-A card with the store unchanged. So the tool works and what is missing is CLEAN RUNS (K>=3), every loss being the model's degenerate output after a successful motif_search.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a binding lands with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR the op chosen is not `bind` when the user said attach — its enum is bind|unbind and `unbind` would remove a binding never asked about — OR the model invents a node_id or motif_id. A run that ends with no prose and no card is D-SILENT-TURN-NO-CARD-NO-PROSE, a MODEL-output defect: re-run it, do not read it as 0/5.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a node_id or motif_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — the same binding twice must not create two applications.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — the node is book-scoped and the motif ACCOUNT-scoped.

_fixture_note: Plan seeds assert that a run EXISTS, never its status: mode='rules' compiles a two-arc document and leaves a one-arc document proposed. Asserting either cost a full arm.
